name: JL_BR_AR_DISTRIBUTNS_ALL
description: This is an obsolete table and not in use.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Bank occurrence distribution identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Bank collection document identifier.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_LINK_TYPE
columns.description: Bank occurrence distribution link type code.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_TYPE
columns.description: Bank occurrence distribution type code.

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: ENTERED_AMT
columns.description: Distribution amount. This is the endorsement amount if distribution type is receivables endorsement, bank charges amount if it is bank charges and factoring charges amount if it is receivables factoring.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Entered currency code on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: ACCTD_AMT
columns.description: Distribution amount in ledger currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate at which the principal unit of one currency can be converted into another currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date of the conversion rate for one currency to another currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type for one currency to another currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_REVERSAL_OPTION
columns.description: Yes or No indicates whether the distribution row reverses any other distribution row.

columns.name: REVERSED_DIST_ID
columns.description: Reversed distribution identifier on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: REVERSED_DIST_LINK_TYPE
columns.description: Reversed distribution link type code on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: PRIOR_DIST_ID
columns.description: Prior distribution identifier. This is the distribution identifier of a remittance occurrence corresponding to a return occurrence.

columns.name: PRIOR_DIST_LINK_TYPE
columns.description: Prior distribution link type code on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Subledger accounting event identifier for a distribution.

columns.name: EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Subledger accounting event occurrence date.

columns.name: OCCURRENCE_ID
columns.description: Bank correction identifier on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: BANK_OCCURRENCE_CODE
columns.description: Bank occurrence code on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: STD_OCCURRENCE_CODE
columns.description: Standard occurrence code. Values are from the lookups JLBR_AR_REMIT_BANK_OCCURENCE and JLBR_AR_RETURN_BANK_OCCURENCE.

columns.name: BORDERO_TYPE
columns.description: Bank transfer batch type on a bank occurrence distribution.

columns.name: BANK_OCCURRENCE_TYPE
columns.description: Bank occurrence type. Values are from the lookup JLBR_AR_BANK_OCCURENCE_TYPE.

columns.name: DIST_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Bank occurrence distribution number.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
